# stb 2026.07.02

- [This project discusses security-relevant bugs in public in Github Issues and Pull Requests, and it may take significant time for security fixes to be implemented or merged. If this poses an unreasonable risk to your project, do not use stb libraries.](https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/master/README.md)
